specifications.value: Eight M2 mounting-hole envelopes, 2.5 mm deep, with 12 mm pitch on each side; smooth bores represent the nominal thread envelope. The axial hole offset, board thicknesses, screw heads, connector dimensions and housing split are reconstructed.

specifications.label: Connector evidence
specifications.value: UC reference board shows both Type-C and a five-pin connector. Interface functionality follows the table per model; the presence of both connectors does not establish dual video output. Supplied five-pin diagram labels 1 RX, 2 TX, 3 CVBS, 4 GND, 5 4.5–18 V. These labels are reference evidence, not a verified mating-side wiring layout.

specifications.label: Thermal sensitivity
specifications.value: Source upper bound ≤25 mK at f/1.0, 50 Hz, 300 K.

specifications.label: Frame-rate evidence
specifications.value: Detector frame rate, as labeled in the UC table; USB streaming throughput and progressive CVBS frame rate are not established.

specifications.label: Geometry limitations
specifications.value: Lens surfaces, board electronics and connectors are visual/mechanical envelopes. Focal length is not the external lens diameter. No optical performance or circuitry is simulated.

specifications.label: Other published properties
specifications.value: Operating −20 to +60 °C; 80 g / 4 ms shock. Digital zoom 1×–8×; NUC/brightness/contrast controls listed. Test conditions and host compatibility are not independently verified.
